mostWorthwhile.text: Forming the giant's gas disk and then its rubble moon was most worthwhile: the intermediate step clarified how material gathers around the planet.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the slow ice-rich pieces yielded no partners and did not identify the missing step, though it narrowed the search.

surprise.text: The slow pieces could not combine directly with the giant; they needed a surrounding gas disk first.

arbitrary.text: The initial attempt to put frost-coated dust in the cold ring felt like a reasonable guess, but the game instead paired it with stones automatically.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: following the same material into a giant, a distant reservoir and a moon made the different outcomes interesting.
